records.preserveReason: Dorado is the conventional common species name used to distinguish this specific game fish.

records.source: A fierce carnivore with brilliant orange scales.
records.translation: Mabangis na karniborong may maningning na kahel na kaliskis.

records.englishResidueReason: Dragon is a familiar Filipino fantasy loanword and preserves the item's in-world creature association.

records.source: These are rumored to be the teeth of ancient serpents. The enamel is made of pure iridium!
records.translation: Sinasabing mga ngipin ito ng mga sinaunang ahas. Gawa sa purong iridyum ang esmalte!

records.source: The metal tab and colorful streamers create an enticing spectacle for fish. Increases the bite-rate when fishing.
records.translation: Lumilikha ang pirasong metal at makukulay na laso ng kaakit-akit na tanawin para sa isda. Pinatataas ang dalas ng pagkagat habang nangingisda.
Makukunat na piraso ng pinatuyong prutas.
Pakete ng mga de-kalidad na kabute.
Pakete ng mga de-kalidad na kabute.

records.source: A starfish from the primordial ocean. It's an unusually pristine specimen!
records.translation: Bituing-dagat mula sa sinaunang karagatan. Pambihirang mahusay ang pagkakapreserba sa ispesimeng ito!

records.source: A piece of wood from the sea.
records.translation: Piraso ng kahoy mula sa dagat.

records.source: Plays a drum sound when you walk past.
records.translation: Tumutunog na parang tambol kapag nilagpasan mo.
Malinamnam at dilaw na mayonesa ito.

records.source: It's a piece of the advanced technology once known to the dwarves. It's still glowing and humming, but you're unable to understand how it works.
records.translation: Piraso ito ng masulong na teknolohiyang dating taglay ng mga duwende. Kumikinang at umuugong pa rin ito, ngunit hindi mo maunawaan kung paano ito gumagana.

records.source: A yellowed scroll of parchment filled with dwarven script. This one's tied with a red bow.
records.translation: Nanilaw na balumbon ng pergamino na puno ng sulat ng duwende. Nakatali ito sa pulang laso.

records.source: A yellowed scroll of parchment filled with dwarven script. This one's tied with a green ribbon.
records.translation: Nanilaw na balumbon ng pergamino na puno ng sulat ng duwende. Nakatali ito sa berdeng laso.

records.source: A yellowed scroll of parchment filled with dwarven script. This one's tied with a blue rope.
records.translation: Nanilaw na balumbon ng pergamino na puno ng sulat ng duwende. Nakatali ito sa bughaw na lubid.

records.source: A yellowed scroll of parchment filled with dwarven script. This one's tied with a golden chain.
records.translation: Nanilaw na balumbon ng pergamino na puno ng sulat ng duwende. Nakatali ito sa ginintuang kadena.

records.source: It's one of the helmets commonly worn by dwarves. The thick metal plating protects them from falling debris and stalactites.
records.translation: Isa ito sa mga elmong karaniwang isinusuot ng mga duwende. Pinoprotektahan sila ng makapal na metal laban sa nahuhulog na mga tipak at stalaktita.
Gabay sa Pagsasalin ng Wikang Duwende
